findings.highlight: I'll be sure to live my life normally too
findings.evidenceJa: わたしも日々ちゃんと普通に生きてるよ
findings.explanation: Setsuna reassures Haruki that she is already living an ordinary life day by day despite her pain. The translation turns that present fact into a promise about what she will do.
findings.japanese: 『わたしも日々ちゃんと普通に生きてるよ』
findings.todokanai: "I'll be sure to live my life normally too."

findings.highlight: Mari-san, whom I promised to meet, an essential piece of what makes up this crossroad of destiny
findings.evidenceJa: 麻理さんと会う約束をした、あの、運命の分岐点のうちの、重要な一つ
findings.explanation: The phone call on which Haruki arranged to meet Mari was one important fork in fate. The translation makes Mari herself an appositive 'piece' of a singular crossroads, obscuring the causal event he has just identified.
findings.japanese:
麻理さんと会う約束をした、
あの、運命の分岐点のうちの、重要な一つ。
findings.todokanai: Mari-san, whom I promised to meet, an essential piece of what makes up this crossroad of destiny.

findings.highlight: No matter how you look at it, this deadline is stupid
findings.evidenceJa: どっちも締め切りブッチしてるってのに
findings.explanation: Hamada protests that Mari is only one step ahead even though both of them have blown their deadlines. The translation calls the deadline stupid and deletes the admission that both workers missed it.
findings.japanese:
「なんでことごとく俺の一歩だけ先を行きやがる！
どっちも締め切りブッチしてるってのに！」
findings.todokanai: "How are you always one step ahead of me!? No matter how you look at it, this deadline is stupid!"

findings.highlight: how was there ever a time when I was really so deeply in love with this person?
findings.evidenceJa: このひとに深くのめり込んでいった俺は、果たして存在したんだろうか
findings.explanation: Haruki wonders whether his present self—the self who has fallen deeply into Mari—would exist if Setsuna had spoken to him that Wednesday. The translation instead questions whether such love ever existed in the past.
findings.japanese:
今の俺は…
このひとに深くのめり込んでいった俺は、
果たして存在したんだろうか…
findings.todokanai: With the way I am right now… how was there ever a time when I was really so deeply in love with this person?

findings.highlight: her time of ridiculing others was long over
findings.evidenceJa: 人をからかって遊んでる時間帯はとっくに過ぎ去ってるのに
findings.explanation: Haruki notes that it is already far too late at night for Suzuki to be wasting time teasing people, yet she continues. The translation says her period of teasing was over, implying that the action had stopped.
findings.japanese:
大体、人をからかって遊んでる時間帯は
とっくに過ぎ去ってるのにこの人は…
findings.todokanai: For the most part, her time of ridiculing others was long over.

findings.highlight: To be told to go home this early… This is a warning sign to me that something bad has happened…
findings.evidenceJa:
こんな『早い』時間に帰されるなんて、
何か良くないことが起こる前ぶれとしか…
findings.explanation: Haruki treats the early dismissal as an omen that something bad is about to happen; the English says the bad event has already happened.
findings.japanese:
こんな『早い』時間に帰されるなんて、
何か良くないことが起こる前ぶれとしか…
findings.todokanai: To be told to go home this early… This is a warning sign to me that something bad has happened…

findings.highlight: Stay home for as long as you want. Just calling or emailing is fine
findings.evidenceJa: 会社を一歩出たら好きなだけメールでも電話でもすればいい
findings.explanation: Mari sarcastically permits Haruki to email or call as much as he likes once he steps outside the company. The translation invents an instruction to stay home and restricts him to remote contact.
findings.japanese:
「会社を一歩出たら好きなだけ
メールでも電話でもすればいい。
よい週末を」
findings.todokanai: "Stay home for as long as you want. Just calling or emailing is fine. Have a nice weekend."

findings.highlight: I won't even be able to give Mari-san a follow-up call
findings.evidenceJa: 麻理さんが帰った頃を見計らって、フォローの電話を入れなければならない
findings.explanation: Haruki decides the situation is serious enough that he must time a conciliatory call for when Mari gets home. The translation says he will be unable to make that call.
findings.japanese:
これは一度、麻理さんが帰った頃を見計らって、
フォローの電話を入れなければならないレベルの…
findings.todokanai: And I imagine I've messed up so horribly this time that I won't even be able to give Mari-san a follow-up call, judging from when she's going to be back…

findings.highlight: Don't get lost
findings.evidenceJa: 寄り道なんかするなよ
findings.explanation: Mari tells Haruki not to make any detours, the final coded direction that sends him straight to her apartment using the key. 'Don't get lost' changes deliberate destination choice into navigation.
findings.japanese:
「さっさと帰れ。
…寄り道なんかするなよ」
findings.todokanai: "You should go home already. …Don't get lost, okay?"

findings.highlight: I've only got the one I gave you earlier
findings.evidenceJa: 私、カギ持ってないんだ。…さっきお前に渡したやつしか
findings.explanation: Mari has no key because her sole key is the one she gave Haruki. The translation says she still has that key, contradicting both her being locked out and Haruki's possession of it.
findings.japanese:
「モニターの下の解錠ボタン押してくれ。
私、カギ持ってないんだ。
…さっきお前に渡したやつしか」
findings.todokanai: "Could you press the unlock button under the screen? I don't have my key on me. …I've only got the one I gave you earlier."

findings.highlight: she was trying to tell me, "your girlfriend is waiting for you"
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に『彼女を待たせて』いたとしたら
findings.explanation: Haruki considers what would have happened if he really had kept a girlfriend waiting and therefore gone to her instead of Mari's room. The translation makes the condition merely whether Mari intended her earlier sarcastic words.
findings.japanese:
いや、そもそも気づいたとしても、
本当に『彼女を待たせて』いたとしたら。
findings.todokanai: No, even if I did realize that she was trying to tell me, "your girlfriend is waiting for you" in the first place…

findings.highlight: And yet, right now, I can't come to grips with the reality that I happily accept these feelings.
findings.evidenceJa:
なのに、今の俺は、
その気持ちを嬉しく受け止めるだけの真実を
持ちきれないなんて…
findings.explanation: Haruki says he lacks enough truth or honesty to receive Mari's feelings with uncomplicated joy; the English instead says he cannot accept the reality that he does receive them happily, producing a different and opaque claim.
findings.japanese:
なのに、今の俺は、
その気持ちを嬉しく受け止めるだけの真実を
持ちきれないなんて…
findings.todokanai: And yet, right now, I can't come to grips with the reality that I happily accept these feelings.

findings.highlight: If I am, your tiredness won't go away
findings.evidenceJa: 強くしないと疲れ取れないですよ
findings.explanation: Haruki says that unless he presses hard, the fatigue will not come out. The translation's malformed conditional states the opposite: if he is forceful, her fatigue will remain.
findings.japanese:
「強くしないと疲れ取れないですよ。
ほら、このくらい我慢してください。大人なんだから」
findings.todokanai: "If I am, your tiredness won't go away. Just bear with it. You're an adult, aren't you?"

findings.highlight: As I thoroughly explored her feet, Mari-san's expression changed from one of ecstasy to one of agony.
findings.evidenceJa:
俺に足の裏をがっちりと極められ、
麻理さんの表情が恍惚から苦痛へと変わる。
findings.explanation: Haruki has Mari's sole firmly locked in a painful pressure-point hold; the English says he merely 'explored her feet,' erasing the action that changes ecstasy to pain.
findings.japanese:
俺に足の裏をがっちりと極められ、
麻理さんの表情が恍惚から苦痛へと変わる。
findings.todokanai: As I thoroughly explored her feet, Mari-san's expression changed from one of ecstasy to one of agony.

findings.highlight: as I lift up her well-toned feet
findings.evidenceJa: その肉付きのいい脚を持ち上げ
findings.explanation: Mari lies back, removes her stockings, and raises her own shapely legs while looking invitingly at Haruki. The translation makes Haruki lift them, altering who initiates the sexualized pose.
findings.japanese:
ベッドに身体を横たえ、ストッキングを脱ぎ、
その肉付きのいい脚を持ち上げ、
俺を誘うような視線を向けて…
findings.todokanai: She's lying on the bed on her back with her stockings pulled off, and as I lift up her well-toned feet, she looks at me with a seductive gaze…

findings.highlight: just to be criticized by you
findings.evidenceJa: 休みになると北原に責められて
findings.explanation: Mari jokes that on her days off Haruki sexually ravishes or relentlessly works her over. The translation reads the erotic seme-ru as ordinary criticism, breaking the stamina joke.
findings.japanese:
「仕事で疲れ果てて帰ってきて、
なのに休みになると北原に責められて、
くたくたのまま、また仕事に出かけて…」
findings.todokanai: "I get tired from work, and then I finally get some time off just to be criticized by you, and then I have to go to work again even though I'm exhausted…"

findings.highlight: "Y…Yeah… It's enough…"
findings.evidenceJa:
「う、うん…
それ、結構…」
findings.explanation: Mari says the massage feels quite good; 'It's enough' instead tells Haruki to stop, reversing the line's practical force.
findings.japanese:
「う、うん…
それ、結構…」
findings.todokanai: "Y…Yeah… It's enough…"

findings.highlight: someone who knows what I want and agrees with it
findings.evidenceJa: 私の意図を正確に汲んでくれること。こちらの会話にきっちり合わせてキャッチボールできること
findings.explanation: Mari values a partner who accurately reads her intent and can sustain a properly matched back-and-forth conversation. The translation replaces reciprocity with agreement or compliance.
findings.japanese:
「私が相手に求めるのは、
私の意図を正確に汲んでくれること。こちらの会話に
きっちり合わせてキャッチボールできること」
findings.todokanai: "What I search for in a partner is someone who knows what I want and agrees with it. Our conversations should always connect like we're playing catch."

findings.highlight: You've returned my warmth to me. And you've done so much more
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の体温を、与えてあげる。そしてもっともっと、あなたを
findings.explanation: Haruki gives Mari his body heat and trails into what more he will do to her. The translation reverses the transfer, saying Mari returned warmth to Haruki and already did more for him.
findings.japanese:
俺の体温を、与えてあげる。
そしてもっともっと、あなたを…
findings.todokanai: You've returned my warmth to me. And you've done so much more…

findings.highlight: my tongue crawled over her leg
findings.evidenceJa: 足の裏に舌を這わせると
findings.explanation: Haruki runs his tongue specifically over the sole of Mari's foot. The translation relocates the action to her leg, losing the fetishized body part that drives her reaction.
findings.japanese:
足の裏に舌を這わせると、
震えが全身に伝播し、
拗ねたような、泣きそうな表情を象っていく。
findings.todokanai: As my tongue crawled over her leg, the shivers spread to her whole body, and she put on a pouting expression that suggested she was about to cry.

findings.highlight: Just confirm what you need to do
findings.evidenceJa: 自分ですべきこと確認しただけよ
findings.explanation: To explain away 'hook my bra' to the caller, Mari claims she was merely checking aloud what she herself needed to do. The translation gives the caller an imperative to confirm their own tasks.
findings.japanese:
「………自分ですべきこと確認しただけよ。
誰もいないってば」
findings.todokanai: "…Just confirm what you need to do. There's no one else."

findings.highlight: the fact that nothing seems to be impossible for her
findings.evidenceJa: 決して無理をしていないふうなのが
findings.explanation: Mari's manner and expression do not look forced despite the abrupt work demand; Haruki reads that composure as strength and kindness. The translation turns the absence of visible strain into limitless capability.
findings.japanese:
その仕草や表情が、
決して無理をしていないふうなのが、
彼女の強さと、優しさなんだろうな。
findings.todokanai: Her actions, her expressions, and the fact that nothing seems to be impossible for her all attest to her strength and kindness.

findings.highlight: I was the one who was played with, in a good way
findings.evidenceJa: またいいように弄ばれただけ
findings.explanation: Mari ruefully says Haruki again toyed with her however he pleased, despite her plan to lead. The translation makes the treatment positively 'in a good way,' muting her complaint about lost control.
findings.japanese:
「お前には物足りなかったんじゃないか？
今日こそは私が導いてやろうと思ってたのに、
結局、またいいように弄ばれただけだったし…」
findings.todokanai: "Aren't you unsatisfied? I thought it would be me taking the lead today, but again I was the one who was played with, in a good way…"

findings.highlight: These are really good. Seriously, people can't live without them
findings.evidenceJa: いざ自分がその立場になると………いいなぁこれ。ホント、人間って都合のいい生き物だよなぁ
findings.explanation: Mari admits that once she occupies the romantic-comic situation herself, it feels wonderful, and wryly calls humans self-serving creatures. The translation turns the scene into plural objects people cannot live without.
findings.japanese:
「いざ自分がその立場になると………いいなぁこれ。
ホント、人間って都合のいい生き物だよなぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Come on, once you get to where I… These are really good. Seriously, people can't live without them."

findings.highlight: I promised Takahiro that I'd get him a reference book
findings.evidenceJa: 孝宏の参考書探しにつきあう約束してて
findings.explanation: Setsuna claims she promised to accompany Takahiro while he looked for study guides. The translation says she promised to obtain a single book for him, removing the shared outing that the following sibling scene exposes as a pretext.
findings.japanese:
『日曜日は先約があるの。
孝宏の参考書探しにつきあう約束してて』
findings.todokanai: "I have plans for Sunday. I promised Takahiro that I'd get him a reference book."

findings.highlight: if he even has the intention of studying properly this year
findings.evidenceJa: もしかして、今年は練習のつもりなのかな
findings.explanation: Setsuna jokes that perhaps Takahiro regards this year's actual entrance exam as merely a practice attempt. The translation instead questions whether he intends to study at all.
findings.japanese:
『あと一月もしないうちに入試本番なのに、
相変わらずのんきな弟でしょう？
もしかして、今年は練習のつもりなのかな？』
findings.todokanai: "As usual, he's such a carefree younger brother, even though he has entrance exams in less than a month. I wonder if he even has the intention of studying properly this year?"

findings.highlight: Saturday would have been open for her
findings.evidenceJa: しかも結局土曜が空いて
findings.explanation: Haruki thought he himself could not make Saturday, switched the invitation to Sunday, then unexpectedly became free on Saturday. The translation assigns that newly open Saturday to Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
土曜日は駄目だと思って日曜にしたら、
日曜は向こうがＮＧで、
しかも結局土曜が空いて…
findings.todokanai: I thought I couldn't make it on Saturday so I tried for Sunday, but it's no good for her on that day, and not only that, but Saturday would have been open for her…

findings.highlight: we are going out of our way to avoid one another
findings.evidenceJa: すれ違うことが義務づけられてでもいるんだろうか
findings.explanation: Haruki wonders whether he and Setsuna are somehow fated or condemned to keep missing each other. The translation assigns both of them deliberate effort to avoid one another.
findings.japanese:
にしても…
今の俺と雪菜は、
すれ違うことが義務づけられてでもいるんだろうか。
findings.todokanai: Still… with the way Setsuna and I are right now, I wonder if we are going out of our way to avoid one another.
